fix: Rule R0298 already maps 'narrowly ellipsoid' to elliptic PATO:0000947 (synonym ellipsoid), with 'narrowly' kept as a cue. Annotate seed elliptic. The 14-22 mm in the same clause is a separate statement and must not be attached to the shape statement, so it must not send it to the unit gate.

fix: Ground 'crown' of a tree to shoot system PO:0009006 (synonym 'tree crown'). Rejoin the detached 'to pyramidal' with 'rounded crown' and read it as a continuum from rounded to pyramidal PATO:0002336. 'scraggly' is vague and is dropped.

fix: Read it as one_of: (lanceolate PATO:0001877 to linear-lanceolate, a continuum) or linear-oblong (a continuum of linear PATO:0001199 and oblong). The bearer is the leaf lamina. If nested continua cannot be operands yet, annotate the union lanceolate | linear | oblong of the leaf blade.

fix: 'elevated' → prominent PATO:0001482 (rule C320) on leaf midvein PO:0020139. For relief qualities (prominent, impressed) on veins, read 'adaxially' as the adaxial side of the lamina (a pinned BSPO region, slot 1), not as epidermis substitution. That substitution is limited to colours and hairs.

fix: Split '3-5-toothed' with the 'toothed' row of flora_counted_parts.tsv: count of teeth 3-5, container leaf lamina (blade). Read 'near the apex' as a count_position of kind at_region (apex), and keep 'shallowly' as a degree cue in RDF.

fix: When 'thick' follows a number with a unit, map it to the attribute thickness PATO:0000915 as a measurement (1.5-2 mm), not to increased thickness (Q72). The bearer is rhizome PO:0004542.

fix: Leave held. 'não visto(s)' (not seen) should be a cue that blocks annotation, never a negation.
reason: Fruit and seed were not seen on the type material. This says nothing about the plant, and it is not absence.

target: leaf-climbing: climbing by means of twining or clasping petioles, petiolules or leaf rachises

fix: Read French 'fleurs à N bractéoles' as a count of bracteole PO:0009043 = 2 with container flower. Add the 'à N <part>' (with N parts) cue. '2 fleurs' per 'nœud florifère' is a separate count at a position (pattern 14, per_node).

fix: Add the Spanish 'cartáceo/cartácea' as a synonym rule to papyraceous PATO:0104010 (synonym chartaceous). The bearer is the corolla.

fix: Annotate corolla PO:0009059 with rotate FLOPO:0991125. The 'ca. 1.5 cm' in the clause is a separate length statement and must not hold the shape.

fix: 'narrowly ovate' grounds to ovate FLOPO:0991024 (rules R0421/R1643/C125), so both ends of the continuum are the same class. Collapse it to the plain value ovate on panicle inflorescence PO:0030123, with 'narrowly' as a cue.

fix: Leave held. 'disintegrating to fibers' in the same clause is a separate statement (see P00104).

fix: Bearer calyx tooth with has position upper FLOPO:0991376 (pattern 18), and increased length PATO:0000573 towards calyx tooth, where the second term is the other members of the same series. The superlative cue 'les plus longues' goes in RDF; 'subégales' (subequal) is a separate record.

fix: Add 'in bud' (and 'en bouton') as a bud-stage reading: the bearer is part_of flower bud PO:0000056, as in rule R3685 / pattern 12. Petals imbricate FLOPO:0991063 is a quality of the corolla towards its petals (pattern 16).

fix: The bearer is the pinna lobe, grounded to leaf lamina lobe PO:0025517. Read 'apices' as the apex region (slot 1) with acuminate PATO:0002228. The 'often with several acute teeth' is a separate record with frequency often.

fix: Give 'liana' its entity + quality reading instead of the primitive FLOPO_0900035: whole plant PO:0000003 with climbing FLOPO:0991108 and ligneous PATO:0002348. Add the Spanish 'bejuco(s)' as a synonym. 'delgados' (slender) is vague and is dropped.

fix: Read 'broken up into N <part>' as a count: anther locule PO:0025264 = 20-60, container anther. The anther is also locellate FLOPO:0991277.

fix: Count of heads (capitulum) = 1, with the operand 2-3 at frequency rarely. The condition 'from proximal branches' stays in RDF as a cue. The container is the stem.

fix: Indefinite count 'several' (pattern 13) of flowers with count_position per_axil and the cue 'in each axil'. 'usually' is a frequency.

fix: Add the French cue 'par aisselle' → per_axil. Count of inflorescences 1-4.

fix: Add 'none' as an absence cue and 'apparently' as a hedge qualifier in RDF (status review). The bearer is the inflorescence with bract PO:0009055 absent.

fix: Two records: scape erect, and scape stout → increased thickness PATO:0000591. For bromeliads, ground 'scape' to peduncle PO:0009053 rather than stem.

fix: Read the hyphenated compound 'linear-oblanceolate' as the continuum linear PATO:0001199 – oblanceolate PATO:0002330 on the leaf lamina. The 12-16 × 1.2-3 cm is a separate measurement.

fix: one_of operands on the same bearer (central = terminal leaflet), each with its own bearer_scope: glabrous, or the adaxial surface (leaf lamina adaxial epidermis by slot 1) appressed-puberulent. In OWL, a union of the two defining properties (has characteristic some glabrous, or has part some (adaxial epidermis and has characteristic some puberulent)). In RDF, per-operand scope and cue.
